prompts.discarded_original_based:
Create one finished photographic beauty campaign portrait for TAM Beauty lip oil. This is a reference-led revision, not a collage.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1: existing TAM generated portrait. Main reference for the attractive adult woman's facial appeal, elegant wide attentive eyes, delicate oval face, fresh soft expression, long dark hair, pale pink-white campaign palette, white clothing, and TAM bottle/applicator. The owner likes THIS face much more than attempts to narrow her eyes or broaden her face. Preserve its attractive impression; do NOT deliberately shrink the eyes, make her stern, older, tired, or add roughness.
Image 2: real rom&nd campaign photograph. Reference ONLY for the coherent photographic skin tones, believable eyelids, lip texture and delicate real makeup finish. Do not copy the person's identity, costume, brand, border, overlays or exact pose.
Image 3: real Dior campaign photograph. Reference ONLY for actual beauty photography: slightly direct studio light, coherent cast shadows, highlight falloff, separation between shiny lips and skin, and crisp camera rendition. Do not copy the person's identity, stars, costume, Dior packaging, mirror or composition.
PRIMARY REQUEST: The existing TAM portrait looks computer-rendered. Re-photograph this campaign as a real contemporary studio beauty shoot with a fresh fictional adult East Asian model in her mid twenties retaining the prettiness and delicate facial proportions of image 1. The entire image must have a consistent photographic treatment, not an AI face with a pore texture pasted over it. Keep bright elegant commercial polish. A living, warm attentive expression, relaxed lips during application, subtle softness at mouth corners. Natural variation between individual lashes and brows; no radial eyelash fan, no too-perfect doll eyes. Keep skin clear, lightly retouched, naturally smooth. No added freckles, blemishes, aging, heavy pores or artificial grain.
PHOTOGRAPHY: use a large near-camera studio flash offset slightly to camera left, with soft but visible nose and jaw shadows and a gentle reflected fill. Optical photographic contrast and realistic tonal transitions on face, hands and neck. Retain clean pink-white background, rich dark hair with slightly less towering volume, true-color skin with no orange cast, no desaturation or gray film look. Moderately satin cheeks and forehead, localized small highlights, lips have translucent coral-rose gloss and natural creases. Sharp camera focus without oversharpened pore detail. Lens 85mm, beauty portrait, credible depth rather than airbrushed gradients.
COMPOSITION: vertical 4:5 from upper chest to top of hair. Similar size of face and position in frame to image 1 so this fits the same product page. Slightly more upright head, engaged gaze towards camera, grooming and white knit neckline consistent with image 1. Hold the single TAM bottle naturally near the lower left side of the face and the rounded applicator gently at the lower lip, matching the original packaging accurately. Clear rectangular body, coral oil, exact white 'tam' with small 'BEAUTY', transparent cap and white stem. Anatomically coherent hands and actual grip. The product stays secondary to the face but legible. No other brand. No poster typography. No watermark. One new photographic image only.
Priority: maintain beauty of original TAM face; improve coherent studio photography and lively natural expression. Do not repeat the rigid narrowed-eye modifications of prior variants.
prompts.new_photo_based:
EDIT IMAGE 1, a real studio beauty photograph, into a new TAM Beauty campaign. Use its photographic capture as the foundation. One single vertical 4:5 photograph, not a collage.
Image1 (Dior photograph): EDIT TARGET. Keep its convincing real-camera rendering, actual dimensional facial lighting, photographic skin color response, defined soft-edged shadows, relaxed product-application moment, straight dark hair and tight upper-chest portrait framing. Recompose into a plain soft pale-pink studio background, remove the entire mirror border, all star decorations and all Dior products, Dior lettering and costume hardware.
Image2 (original TAM synthetic portrait): ONLY reference for TAM bottle design, applicator, clean white clothing and the owner's preferred pretty, soft feminine impression. Do NOT use its airy plastic rendering, puffy hair or original pose as the foundation.
Replace the recognizable face of image1 with a completely DIFFERENT fictional adult East Asian woman aged 26. She must not be identifiable as the celebrity in image1. A delicate oval face, soft cheeks, slightly wide-set warm brown eyes with naturally rounded attentive shape, gently arched fine brows, modest natural nose, fresh coral-pink glossy lips. A distinctive but beautiful cosmetics model, not an exaggerated AI beauty template. Her eyes should feel bright and engaged with the photographer. A relaxed, almost smiling expression, lips slightly parted while applying gloss. Real eyelids, individual lashes of varying lengths, genuine facial planes and coherent anatomy. Clear professionally made-up skin, understated satin foundation; true photographic tonal variation. Do not add freckles, spots, tiredness, large pores, wrinkles or grain. No narrowed sleepy eyes or stern expression.
Wardrobe: simple clean white sleeveless knit, long smooth black-brown hair naturally falling behind shoulders, no huge teased volume, no earrings copied from image1.
Replace both Dior tubes with ONE TAM lip oil bottle held by one hand, and its open applicator held by the other hand; natural five-finger grips. The TAM bottle must match image2: transparent compact rectangular vial with coral oil and white italic lowercase 'tam' with tiny 'BEAUTY' beneath; clear square cap, white wand and generous rounded coral flocked tip. No metal silver cap. Put the applicator lightly at the lower lip, the bottle near the cheek but not hiding face. Remove all other products.
Photographic priority: preserve the real-photo quality of image1. Soft direct studio strobe giving believable under-nose and under-chin shadows, rich dark hair, controlled small skin highlights, luminous but naturally textured glossy lips. Bright clean exposure and neutral skin, pale blush backdrop, no gray or muddy color. This is professional cosmetics photography with light retouching, not a render, painting or airbrushed fantasy face. No symmetry filter or wax skin. Do not merely transfer the synthetic face from image2.
No text beyond the small TAM label. No watermark, frame or campaign graphics. Final one new studio photograph.
